meter.record: uv run meter_run.py record --book prep3-parallel --stage S2-S4,S8 --run <runId>
meter.by_stage: uv run meter_run.py summary --book prep3-parallel --by phase
meter.by_lesson: uv run meter_run.py summary --book prep3-parallel --by lesson
meter.note: Phase titles start with their stage (S2, S3, S4, S8), so `--by phase` is the per-stage cost; every label carries the lesson slug (S3:blind:<slug>:1), so `--by lesson` is the per-lesson cost.
